perks.name: Founder's Blessing
perks.description: Your legacy inspires everyone: +5% income per tier, in every era.

perks.name: Master Builders
perks.description: Veteran crews work cheaper: level-ups cost 10% less per tier.

perks.name: Inheritance
perks.description: Start every era with the cash for its first 3, 5 or 8 buildings.

perks.name: Level Floor
perks.description: New buildings open already levelled up: level 5, then level 8.

perks.name: Extra Milestone
perks.description: Level 75 becomes a milestone: one more x2 on every building that reaches it.

perks.name: Good Neighbours
perks.description: Each neighbour on the server adds 4% income instead of 3%, up to 36%.

perks.name: Long Memory
perks.description: Your city keeps earning longer: +2 h on your offline cap per tier.

perks.name: Sign Title
perks.description: A title on your plot sign that grows grander with every rebirth.

perks.name: Name-Tag Colour
perks.description: A teal name tag over your head that every player can see.

perks.name: Monument Glow
perks.description: Your monument glows in every era, day and night.

perks.name: Advance Fireworks
perks.description: Fireworks over your monument whenever you advance or rebirth.

perks.name: Golden Roads
perks.description: Roads, rails and other unlocks on your plot shine in warm gold.
